newsitem.title: EGYPT: First Arab ministers arrive for Cairo meeting.
newsitem.headline: First Arab ministers arrive for Cairo meeting.

text.p: Ministers from Libya, Tunisia and the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) arrived in Cairo on Thursday evening for two days of meetings of Arab foreign ministers starting on Friday.
The meetings will focus on the obstacles to progress towards Middle East peace but the tension between Iraq and the United States is bound to come up too, diplomats say.
The Libyan minister for Unity Affairs, Jomaa al-Fezzani, told reporters at Cairo airport that Libya "denounces the unjustified U.S. attacks and threats" against Iraq.
The other arrivals were Tunisian Foreign Minister Habib Ben Yahia and Farouk Kaddoumi, the head of the PLO'S political department or foreign minister.
The other ministers are expected on Friday.
